title: AI Component Metadata
description: Schema for AI-consumable design system component metadata. Enables intelligent UI generation and component selection.

$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema for IDE validation and autocomplete.

description.description: Brief, one-sentence description of the component's purpose.

path.description: Relative path to the component source file from project root.

figma.description: Links to the exact Figma component. Enables AI agents and Code Connect tools to resolve the component in Figma without guessing.

fileKey.description: Figma file key — the segment after /design/ in the file URL: figma.com/design/FILE_KEY/...

nodeId.description: Figma node ID of the component frame or set, as it appears in the URL (?node-id=1-234). Use colon format (1:234) for the REST API.

componentKey.description: Stable Figma component key from the REST API. Does not change on rename or file move — use this for durable references.

usage.description: How and when to use this component.

useCases.description: List of scenarios where this component is the right choice.

requiredProps.description: Props that must always be provided.

commonPatterns.description: Recommended composition patterns with example code.

composition.description: How this component relates to other components.

slots.description: Named content areas. Keys are slot names, values describe what goes there.

nestedComponents.description: Sub-components that compose this component (e.g. CardHeader, CardContent).

commonPartners.description: Components frequently used alongside this one.

dependencies.description: npm packages this component depends on.

responsive.description: Context-dependent responsive strategies that cannot be encoded in the component itself. Only use this when there are multiple valid approaches on narrow viewports and the right choice depends on how the component is being used (e.g. a table that could collapse to cards or hide columns depending on the data). Do not use for universal rules that always apply — those belong in the component's CSS.

keyboardSupport.description: How the component responds to keyboard input.

screenReader.description: How screen readers announce this component.

variants.description: Available variants. Keys are variant dimensions (e.g. 'variant', 'size'), values map option names to their styling or description.

aiHints.description: Hints to help AI select and use this component correctly.

priority.description: How often this component should be considered. High = commonly used.

keywords.description: Trigger words that suggest this component (used for intent matching).

context.description: Natural language guidance for when to use this component.
